## Activity

During January 2025, North City Eye Clinic recorded 541 captures. The activity total reflects the imaging completed by the clinic team during the reporting month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity information provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the site.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 5 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 0.9. The result is reported alongside the overall activity total to support routine monitoring of image quality. No further interpretation is applied in this report; the figures provide a clear summary of the images that could not be graded.

## Grading

A total of 132 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 9 days. This measure summarises the time between image capture and completion of grading during January 2025. Together, the referable result count and the median lag describe the grading workload and the timeliness of reporting for North City Eye Clinic. These results should be considered with the activity and image quality measures above when reviewing routine site operations.
